headline: Anthropic faces valuation cut of up to $1.2 trillion ahead of IPO
summary: Potential investors have lowered Anthropic PBC's anticipated valuation by up to $1.2 trillion ahead of its planned initial public offering, driven by post-election sell-offs.
why: Initial public offerings are critical liquidity events for private tech companies and their early investors, while valuation adjustments reflect shifts in market sentiment for high-growth artificial intelligence firms.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Potential investors reduced the expected pre-IPO valuation of the company.
